blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (حَافِظُوا عَلَي الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلوةِ الْوُسْطَي ق وَقُومُوا للهِ قنِتِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Guard (by praying without missing) the (five daily) Salahs and the middle Salah (that is, the Asr Salah); and stand before Allah in humble obedience.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلوةِ ؕ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَي الْخشِعِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And seek help (from Allah) through patience and Salah; surely it (that Salah) is indeed a great burden (for others) except for those who have humility in their hearts.

blocks.text:
Note:- Patience means controlling the desires of the self and fulfilling all the commands of Allah. Bearing hardship during difficulty is also patience (Kashf ar-Rahman). Through this verse we are commanded to seek help through patience and Salah in order to act according to the Din.
(Fath al-Mulhim)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۞ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خشِعُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: The believers (in the One God) have certainly succeeded - they are those who are humble in their Salah.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَا مِنِ
